value.paragraph: build a little murder trivia mystery game that follows the standard Clue style rule set, but uses an LLM (api key and endpoint, or oauth token) to answer questions and move the game forward (acts like a game master). This mini-app also needs to be planning partner and nahel driven. use the nahel features you are building to build a simple murder mystery clue like game using an LLM as a scenrario builder and simple game master; this tests that we are using different agents, llms, etc and that the token cost is shared and such.
